name: Nightmares
overview: Scripture assures believers that God provides peace and safety even in the midst of fearful night experiences. The psalmist expresses confidence in laying down to sleep without fear because the LORD alone grants secure dwelling and protection from nighttime terrors. Trusting in God's care enables restful sleep, as He is described as a keeper and shade, giving sweet rest to His beloved. These truths encourage believers to rely on God's presence to overcome the fear and unrest often associated with nightmares.
